items.summaryZh: 斯坦福大学与 Arc Institute 团队用 AI 模型 Evo 从零设计完整病毒基因组，并在实验室构建出 16 种自然界不存在的功能性病毒。Evo 提出 70 万个候选基因组，团队仅筛选最有希望的 285 个序列合成并植入细菌，其中 16 个成功复制并杀死宿主。该研究已通过同行评审发表于《Science》，但 Evo 未接受人类病原体数据训练，且能否推广至其他病毒类群仍是未知数。
items.summaryEn: A team from Stanford University and Arc Institute used the AI model Evo to design complete viral genomes from scratch, and constructed 16 functional viruses in the lab that do not exist in nature. Evo proposed 700,000 candidate genomes, and the team synthesized and implanted only the most promising 285 sequences into bacteria, of which 16 successfully replicated and killed the host. The study has been peer-reviewed and published in Science, but Evo was not trained on human pathogen data, and whether it can generalize to other viral groups remains unknown.
items.detailZh:
斯坦福大学和 Arc Institute 的研究团队利用他们开发的 AI 模型 Evo，从零开始设计了完整的病毒基因组。Evo 是一个基于基因组数据训练的 AI 模型，能够生成新的 DNA 序列。团队让 Evo 提出了 70 万个候选病毒基因组，然后通过计算筛选，选出最有希望的 285 个序列进行合成。这些序列被植入细菌中，最终有 16 个成功复制并杀死了宿主细菌，证明了这些 AI 设计的病毒是功能性的。

这项研究已经通过同行评审，并发表在《Science》杂志上。值得注意的是，Evo 模型并未接受人类病原体数据的训练，因此其设计能力可能仅限于特定类型的病毒。此外，该研究是否能够推广到其他病毒类群，如感染人类的病毒，仍然是一个未知数。尽管如此，这一成果展示了 AI 在合成生物学中的巨大潜力，可能为未来的病毒研究和医学应用开辟新途径。

items.impactZh: 这项研究对合成生物学和医学研究具有重要影响。AI 设计病毒的能力可能加速疫苗开发、基因治疗和病毒学研究。然而，这也引发了生物安全和伦理方面的担忧，因为 AI 可能被用于设计有害病原体。研究人员和监管机构需要制定相应的安全措施。

items.summaryOriginal: 小红书联合浙江大学、复旦大学提出 CULTURE-MT，这是首个面向中英社媒笔记翻译、兼顾文化符号传递与情感共鸣的评测基准，并首次提出「文化有效性」评估标准与自动评估模型 JUDGER（准确率 86.03%）。

items.titleEn: CULTURE-MT: First Benchmark for Cultural Effectiveness in Social Media Translation by Xiaohongshu, Zhejiang University, and Fudan University, Accepted at ICML 2026
items.summaryZh: 小红书联合浙江大学、复旦大学提出 CULTURE-MT，这是首个面向中英社媒笔记翻译、兼顾文化符号传递与情感共鸣的评测基准，并首次提出「文化有效性」评估标准与自动评估模型 JUDGER（准确率 86.03%）。
items.summaryEn: Xiaohongshu, together with Zhejiang University and Fudan University, proposes CULTURE-MT, the first benchmark for evaluating cultural effectiveness in Chinese-English social media note translation, introducing a new evaluation standard and an automatic evaluator JUDGER with 86.03% accuracy.
items.detailZh:
CULTURE-MT 是首个面向中英社媒笔记翻译的评测基准，由小红书联合浙江大学、复旦大学提出，相关论文入选 ICML 2026。该基准首次提出「文化有效性」评估标准，旨在衡量翻译是否在传递文化符号的同时引发情感共鸣，弥补了传统机器翻译评估仅关注语义准确性的不足。

研究团队构建了包含 1,000 条真实小红书笔记的数据集，涵盖多种文化元素，并设计了细粒度的评估维度。同时，他们提出了自动评估模型 JUDGER，在预测人类判断方面达到 86.03% 的准确率，为大规模评估文化有效性提供了可行方案。

该工作强调，在社媒翻译中，文化符号的传递和情感共鸣至关重要，而现有模型往往难以兼顾。CULTURE-MT 为未来研究提供了标准化的评估工具，有望推动机器翻译在跨文化传播领域的发展。
keyPointsZh: CULTURE-MT 是首个面向中英社媒笔记翻译的评测基准，由小红书、浙大、复旦联合提出。
首次提出「文化有效性」评估标准，兼顾文化符号传递与情感共鸣。
构建了包含 1,000 条真实小红书笔记的数据集。
提出自动评估模型 JUDGER，准确率达 86.03%。
论文入选 ICML 2026。
items.impactZh: 对于机器翻译研究者和开发者，CULTURE-MT 提供了新的评估维度和基准，有助于改进翻译模型的文化适应性。对于社媒平台和跨文化内容创作者，该基准可指导翻译实践，提升内容在目标文化中的接受度。

items.summaryZh: 亚马逊、Cursor、微软、OpenAI 和 Vercel 联合创建了 Agent Plugins，这是一个开放标准，定义了 AI 代理扩展的统一包格式。1.0.0 版本使用 plugin.json 清单文件，并支持代理技能和 MCP 服务器。
items.summaryEn: Amazon, Cursor, Microsoft, OpenAI, and Vercel have jointly created Agent Plugins, an open standard that defines a single package format for AI agent extensions. Version 1.0.0 uses a plugin.json manifest file and supports both agent skills and MCP servers.
items.detailZh:
亚马逊、Cursor、微软、OpenAI 和 Vercel 联合宣布了 Agent Plugins 标准，这是一个开放标准，旨在为 AI 代理扩展定义统一的包格式。该标准版本为 1.0.0，使用 plugin.json 清单文件来描述插件元数据，并支持两种类型的扩展：代理技能（agent skills）和 MCP 服务器。这一举措旨在解决当前 AI 代理插件生态碎片化的问题，使开发者能够一次构建插件，并在多个支持该标准的代理中使用。

该标准由多家行业领导者共同制定，表明 AI 代理领域正在走向标准化和互操作性的方向。通过统一插件格式，开发者可以更高效地分发和复用插件，用户也能在不同代理之间无缝迁移。目前，该标准已获得主要参与者的支持，但具体的技术细节和实现方式尚未完全公开。
keyPointsZh: 亚马逊、Cursor、微软、OpenAI 和 Vercel 联合创建了 Agent Plugins 开放标准。
标准版本为 1.0.0，使用 plugin.json 清单文件。
支持代理技能和 MCP 服务器两种插件类型。
旨在统一 AI 代理插件格式，促进互操作性。
items.impactZh: 对于开发者而言，这一标准有望降低为不同 AI 代理开发插件的成本，提高代码复用率。对于行业而言，标准化有助于构建更健康的生态，避免锁定效应。用户也将受益于更丰富的插件选择和更一致的体验。

items.detailZh:
独立开发者叶小叔利用面壁智能开源的 VoxCPM 模型，成功克隆了一位拥有千万粉丝网红的音色，并搭建了一套实时语音对话系统。该系统采用三段式架构：语音识别（STT）将用户语音转为文本，大语言模型（LLM）生成回复，最后通过 VoxCPM 进行语音合成（TTS）输出。据开发者反馈，TTS 首包延迟不到 1 秒，端到端体感延迟约 2 到 3 秒，实现了接近自然的对话体验。

VoxCPM 是面壁智能开源的一款语音模型，支持声音克隆和高质量语音合成。该案例展示了如何将开源模型应用于实际场景，通过简单的管道组合即可实现实时交互。开发者还分享了搭建过程中的一些细节，但具体代码和配置未在原文中详细展开。

items.titleOriginal: When Privileged Guidance Misaligns: State-Matched Routing and Contextualized Self-Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2608.05219v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Privileged on-policy distillation provides dense supervision for multi-turn agents by allowing a synchronized teacher to re-score the student's response at every turn with access to training-only references, such as successful trajectories. In interactive environments, however, the student's preceding actions continually change the execution state. As the student takes different actions or completes subgoals in a different order, its rollout may reach states not covered by the reference, making the reference an unreliable source of guidance for the state actually reached. Applying privileged distillation indiscriminately therefore creates state--reference mismatch. This mismatch motivates a central objective: providing privileged reference guidance that remains compatible with the student's current execution state. We introduce State-Matched Routing and Contextualized Self-Distillation (SMRC-SD), which explicitly determines when and how a privileged trajectory should guide an on-policy student. At each turn, SMRC-SD verifies whether the student's current execution state matches a supported state along the reference trajectory. Distill

items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2608.05205v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Event-centric intelligent analytical systems heavily depend on explicit causal event knowledge for risk early warning, decision-making support and narrative comprehension. Nevertheless, existing instance-level causal pairs suffer severe generalization deficits on low-frequency long-tail and unseen event combinations. To address this limitation, this work proposes Abstract Event Causal Rule (AECR), a novel relation-level causal abstraction paradigm that transforms concrete cause-effect pairs into generalized abstract causal logic while retaining their intrinsic causal relationships. We design a multi-agent Concrete-to-Abstract Causal Induction (CACI) system coupled with similarity-constrained clustering to distill trustworthy AECRs from noisy raw causal data, based on which two complete AECR knowledge bases are built. To validate the practical utility of abstract causal knowledge, we propose an Abstract Rule-Guided Causal Attention Encoder (AR-GCAE), which injects the retrieved AECRs into the causality Graph Event Prediction (CGEP) benchmark task via rule-guided attention layers and gated representation fusion. We show that these bugs are frequently repairable: inserting a short patch generated by a weak probe model after the same strong-model reasoning prefix can redirect the trajectory toward a correct solution. items.titleOriginal: From Continuous Predictors to Clinical Thresholds: Early Evidence on Performance Trade-offs of Guideline-Based Categorisation for Ischaemic Stroke Outcome Prediction
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2608.05203v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning models achieve strong predictive accuracy for 90-day outcome prediction in acute ischaemic stroke, yet clinical adoption is limited by the misalignment of model explanations with clinicians' reasoning. Motivated by a clinician user study calling for clinical guideline-aligned cut-offs, we ask whether continuous predictors can be replaced by clinically informed categorical encodings without sacrificing performance. On a multi-centre European registry stratified into three treatment cohorts, we compare standard and fully categorised gradient-boosted models, the latter using stroke guideline-aligned, treatment-specific thresholds. The fully categorised models are statistically indistinguishable from their continuous counterparts in two of the treatment cohorts, with a significant drop in predictive accuracy in one cohort. Global feature importance rankings remain consistent, suggesting that discretising continuous predictors into guideline-based categories preserves the core hierarchy of prognostic factors across all treatment groups. items.titleOriginal: Otter: A Time-Aware, History-Conditioned Human Chess AI
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2608.05206v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Otter is a 15.3M-parameter human chess AI that predicts human move selection by modeling play as a time-aware, sequential process rather than treating each position in isolation. It combines two conditioning signals: (1) a move history encoder that conditions predictions on the last 20 moves, capturing opening preferences, positional drift, and intra-game behavioral tendencies; and (2) a time control module that modulates predictions based on clock pressure. Otter is trained on 6.1 billion positions from 117 million Lichess rapid games over 30 days on a single T4 GPU. Otter achieves 55.23% top-1 and 90.95% top-5 move-prediction accuracy, surpassing the prior state-of-the-art human chess model, Maia 2, with far fewer parameters and less training data. Across 11 Elo brackets ( =2000), accuracy peaks at 57.38% in the 1900-1999 bracket. These results show that modeling chess as a time-aware, sequential activity yields more human-accurate move prediction than position-only approaches, using a smaller model. Code, trained models, and complete training logs are publicly released.

items.impactZh: 该方法有望提升音频驱动说话头生成的唇部同步质量，减少伪影，对虚拟数字人、影视制作、游戏等领域具有实际应用价值。

items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2608.05225v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Research agents can increasingly search literature, propose hypotheses, generate code, run experiments, and draft manuscripts from a single topic. However, a research project is not merely a larger task: it is a long-horizon agenda that must be advanced through multiple bounded tasks with distinct but related objectives, parallel alternatives, and dependency-aware sequences. Existing single-task systems often treat the project as one oversized task, produce a flat set of vague or overlapping tasks, or leave task boundaries and execution order to manual coordination. We introduce Project2Task, a graph-guided project-level planning layer for autonomous research. Given a project brief, it represents candidate contributions as innovation atoms and organizes them in a directed lineage graph. items.titleOriginal: datasette 1.0a38
items.summaryOriginal: Release: datasette 1.0a38 This release fixes a SQL injection security issue that affects Datasette instances that serve a mixture of public and private tables in the same database, with access configured using the Datasette permissions system . Site administrators who serve private tables in this way are advised to disable the execute-sql permission ` on that database to prevent users from accessing private tables using raw SQL queries. The bug that has been fixed would have allowed users with access to any public table to execute SQL injection attacks despite that restriction, giving them read-only access to data in private tables in the same database. This fix is also available in Datasette 0.65.3 . Thankfully this particular configuration - private tables and public tables exposed for the same database within the same instance - is likely to be rare. I've not encountered an instance like that myself. Tags: security , sql-injection , datasette

items.summaryOriginal: Simon Willison on Technical Blogging I was interviewed by Cynthia Dunlop for her "Write that blog!" series back in January, but I just realized I never linked to the interview from my own blog! It includes my answers to the following questions: Why did you start blogging – and why do you continue? What has been the most surprising impact of blogging for you? What blog post are you most proud of and why? What post was the most difficult to write and how did you tackle it? Any lessons learned that you want to share with the community? Your advice for people just getting started with blogging? A few blogs that you particularly enjoy? I'll repeat my most important piece of advice here: My number one tip for blogging is to lower your standards! Aim to hit publish while you are still actively unhappy with what you have written, because the only alternative is a huge folder full of drafts and never publishing anything at all. items.summaryZh: Simon Willison 在 Cynthia Dunlop 的“写博客！”系列访谈中分享了他的博客经验，包括为何开始写博客、持续写作的动力、最自豪的文章、最难的写作经历、给新手的建议以及他喜欢的博客。他最重要的建议是“降低标准”，在仍对文章不满意时就发布，因为完美主义只会导致草稿堆积，而读者看不到你眼中的瑕疵。
items.summaryEn: Simon Willison shares his blogging insights in an interview with Cynthia Dunlop, covering why he started blogging, what keeps him going, his proudest post, the hardest post to write, advice for beginners, and blogs he enjoys. His top tip is to 'lower your standards' and publish while still unhappy with the piece, as perfectionism leads to a pile of drafts and readers never see the flaws you perceive.
items.detailZh:
Simon Willison 在 2026 年 1 月接受了 Cynthia Dunlop 的“写博客！”系列访谈，但直到 8 月才在自己的博客上发布链接。访谈涵盖了他写博客的动机、持续写作的原因、最自豪的文章、最难写的文章及应对方法、给社区的建议、给新手的建议以及他喜欢的几个博客。

他反复强调的最重要建议是“降低标准”：在仍然对文章不满意时就点击发布，因为唯一的选择是让草稿堆积如山，永远不发布任何东西。他指出，你眼中的瑕疵对读者来说是不可见的，完美主义是写作的敌人。
keyPointsZh: Simon Willison 在访谈中分享了博客写作的多个方面。
他的首要建议是降低标准，在仍不满意时发布。
完美主义会导致草稿堆积，阻碍内容产出。
读者看不到作者眼中的瑕疵。
items.impactZh: 对于技术写作者和内容创作者，这一建议有助于克服完美主义，提高发布频率，从而建立个人品牌和知识分享。它鼓励实践而非追求完美，对社区内容生态有积极影响。
actionStepsZh: 在写作时设定一个发布截止时间，避免无限修改。
接受初稿的不完美，优先完成而非完美。
将草稿视为迭代过程，发布后可根据反馈改进。

items.titleOriginal: Claude Code is the fastest agent framework but costs nearly three times more than the cheapest rival
items.summaryOriginal: Composio tested Deepseek V4 Flash across four agent frameworks on 30 real-world tasks. Success rates were mostly similar, but costs varied by nearly 3x: OpenCode came in cheapest at $0.073 per task, while Claude Code cost $0.195 despite using the fewest tool calls and output tokens. The choice of framework is mainly a question of price and speed. items.importanceReasonZh: 该报道提供了具体的成本对比数据，对开发者和企业在选择智能体框架时具有实际参考价值，且来源可靠。

items.titleZh: Claude Code 是最快的智能体框架，但成本比最便宜的竞争对手高出近三倍
items.titleEn: Claude Code is the fastest agent framework but costs nearly three times more than the cheapest rival
items.summaryZh: Composio 在 30 个真实世界任务上测试了 Deepseek V4 Flash 在四个智能体框架中的表现。成功率大致相似，但成本差异接近 3 倍：OpenCode 最便宜，每个任务 0.073 美元，而 Claude Code 每个任务 0.195 美元，尽管其工具调用和输出 token 最少。框架的选择主要取决于价格和速度。
items.summaryEn: Composio tested Deepseek V4 Flash across four agent frameworks on 30 real-world tasks. Success rates were mostly similar, but costs varied by nearly 3x: OpenCode came in cheapest at $0.073 per task, while Claude Code cost $0.195 despite using the fewest tool calls and output tokens. The choice of framework is mainly a question of price and speed.
items.detailZh:
根据 Composio 的测试，他们在 30 个真实世界任务上评估了四个智能体框架（包括 Claude Code、OpenCode 等）使用 Deepseek V4 Flash 模型的表现。结果显示，各框架的成功率大致相当，但成本差异显著。OpenCode 每个任务成本最低，为 0.073 美元，而 Claude Code 每个任务成本为 0.195 美元，是最便宜选项的近三倍。有趣的是，Claude Code 使用的工具调用次数和输出 token 数量最少，但成本仍然最高，这可能与其定价策略或内部开销有关。

该测试表明，在选择智能体框架时，除了功能外，价格和速度也是重要考量因素。对于成本敏感的项目，OpenCode 可能是更经济的选择，而 Claude Code 则可能适合对速度有更高要求的场景。
keyPointsZh: Composio 在 30 个真实任务上测试了四个智能体框架，使用 Deepseek V4 Flash 模型。
各框架成功率相似，但成本差异接近 3 倍。
OpenCode 最便宜，每任务 0.073 美元；Claude Code 最贵，每任务 0.195 美元。
Claude Code 工具调用和输出 token 最少，但成本最高。
框架选择主要取决于价格和速度需求。
items.impactZh: 对于开发者和企业，该测试结果提示在选择智能体框架时，应综合考虑成本与性能。如果预算有限，OpenCode 可能更具吸引力；如果追求速度，Claude Code 可能值得额外投入。此外，该测试也强调了评估真实任务成本的重要性，而不仅仅是模型价格。
